preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be at least 1.
For each test case, the number of players to select n must be between 3 and 100.
The sum of squares of the values of n over all test cases must not exceed 10,000.

postconditions.description: The number of selected players must be exactly n.

postconditions.expression: any(i < j for i, j in zip(selected_players, selected_players[1:])) and any(i > j for i, j in zip(selected_players, selected_players[1:]))
postconditions.description: There must be at least two possible orderings of the selected players by strength.
The number of matches organized must not exceed 4n^2.
